title: Akiyama Mizuki — The Flavor You Deserve〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We can finally sit down. How are you two feeling?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm... Actually, my feet are starting to ache. But they felt fine while we were walking through the exhibit...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I know what you mean. Even though we didn't move around much, those kinds of places still suck the energy out of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Exactly... However, Mizuki, I'm glad we're getting to take a break at the place you recommended.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, so... Yes, I did recommend this place, but that's not the whole story...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena was the one who originally found this place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's been wanting to come here because the atmosphere's so relaxing, and their cakes are supposed to look and taste amazing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But we never found a day when we were both free. So, I don't think Ena's had a chance to come here yet...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was actually gonna invite her today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I didn't want to bother her. I mean, she had such a serious look on her face.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, she did.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But still, I was sorta on edge the entire day since I don't really go to solo exhibits.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: On edge?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're not like a regular art museum, you know? Hmm... How do I describe it...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
If these things were concerts...
A museum would be a music festival, and a solo exhibit would be your very own show.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A solo exhibit is like a solo concert, showcasing just your work, while a museum is more like a festival, featuring pieces from various artists.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly!
See? Mafuyu gets it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The fans of some artists make up special, unwritten rules for their shows and performances. For example, they'll wave around red glowsticks for certain songs and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why I kept wondering if it also applied to these kinds of art exhibits. Like, what if you're supposed to cross your arms and look pensive for specific paintings!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I doubt that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. No mercy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, going to new places and seeing different works was really nice. They make a good source of inspiration.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I've got a good feeling about tonight. I feel like I'm gonna get a ton of work done♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Seeing another artist's works makes me think about what they felt throughout their creative process, and what they wanted to express...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That exhibit did end up becoming a good source of inspiration, so I'm looking forward to continuing working on our song tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Inspiration...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, did you feel something too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But that painting felt like something from a different world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A different world...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, those neighborhoods and alleyways didn't look like the ones you would usually see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew it'd be fun to discuss what we saw afterwards!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's interesting how our opinions differ so much.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
This tea was for...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's here♪
You ordered this, right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I ordered the baked cheesecake and she ordered the shortcake!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'll leave these right here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They look so cute, and delicious♪
Now, without further ado... Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mmm!
This cheesecake is so good...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's so rich with cheese, but it doesn't feel heavy at all. And this jam adds the perfect amount of sourness. I could eat this all day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really want Ena to try this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
Do you think she'll like it if we got a slice for her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sure she will.
The menu said that we can get them to go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Alright, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
We'd like to order a slice of cake to go.
